MaterialLease.description:
Private authenticated lease metadata; not a public prompt/profile artifact.
The fingerprint binds exact bytes, never a claim inferred from key presence.

PreparationPlan.description:
Preparation permission is not execution authority. Delivery and a private
binding receipt must complete before the server can issue an actual grant.

grant_id.description:
Last observed grant; None means durable reservation closed before
observing a grant, not a claim that the server never issued one.

Text.description: Nonempty UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control characters.
